arxiv-2206-13860.title: Detection and Forecasting of Extreme event in Stock Price Triggered by Fundamental, Technical, and External Factors
arxiv-2206-13860.creator: Anish Rai, Salam Rabindrajit Luwang and Md Nurujjaman, Chittaranjan Hens, Pratyay Kuila, Kanish Debnath
arxiv-2206-13860.description: Abstract The sporadic large fluctuations are seen in the stock market due to changes in fundamental parameters, technical setups, and external factors. These large fluctuations are termed as Extreme Events (EE). The EEs may be positive or negative depending on the impact of these factors. During such events, the stock price time series is found to be nonstationary.

arxiv-2207-11311.title: Understanding Non-linearity in Graph Neural Networks from the Perspective of Bayesian Inference
arxiv-2207-11311.creator: Rongzhe Wei, Haoteng Yin, Junteng Jia, Austin R. Benson, Pan Li
arxiv-2207-11311.description: Abstract Graph neural networks (GNNs) have shown superiority in many prediction tasks over graphs due to their impressive capability of capturing nonlinear relations in graph-structured data. However, for node classification tasks, often, only marginal improvement of GNNs over their linear counterparts has been observed. Previous works provide very few understandings of this phenomenon.

pmc-11323636.description: BackgroundVitamin D supplementation may prevent acute respiratory infections (ARIs). This study aimed to identify the optimal methods of vitamin D supplementation.MethodsPubMed, Embase, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science, and the ClinicalTrials.gov registry were searched from database inception through July 13, 2023. Randomized-controlled trials (RCTs) were included. Data were pooled using random-effects model.

pmc-11549564.title: Systematic Review of Tools and Approaches for Evaluating the Transferability of Health Technology Assessments Across Different Jurisdictions
pmc-11549564.creator: Elham Ahmadnezhad, Mehrnaz Kheirandish, Ali Akbari-Sari, Arash Rashidian

pmc-11860539.creator: D. Georgaki, C. Kalogirou, A. Potamianou, M. Bakola, P. Gourzis, G. Charalambous, E. Jelastopulu

pmc-12469809.title: Dual Therapeutic Impact of AXL Inhibitor AB-329: Chemotherapy Sensitization and Immune Microenvironment Reprogramming in TNBC
pmc-12469809.creator: Dileep Reddy Rampa, Jon A Fuson, Huey Liu, Max Pan, Yujia Qin, Youping Deng, Naoto T Ueno, Jangsoon Lee, Eileen Brantley
pmc-12469809.description: AXL, a receptor tyrosine kinase, has emerged as a promising therapeutic target in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) due to its critical roles in tumor progression, metastasis, and immune evasion. In this study, we investigated the antitumor efficacy and immunomodulatory potential of AB-329, a selective AXL kinase inhibitor, in preclinical models of TNBC.

pmc-12692368.title: The Gut Microbial Metabolite Indole-3-Acetic Acid Reprograms Systemic Homeostasis and Ameliorates IBD-Associated Cachexia Independent of Food Intake
pmc-12692368.creator: Ayame Tomii, Chihiro Takei, Keisuke Yoshikiyo, Hidehisa Shimizu, Rafał Filip
pmc-12692368.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is associated with severe systemic complications, including cachexia, anemia, and renal dysfunction, which represent a significant unmet medical need. The gut microbial metabolite indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) is known to be reduced in IBD; however, its therapeutic potential remains unclear.

pmc-13103573.title: Metabolic fate of rambutan (Nephelium lappaceum L.) peel polyphenols following oral administration in rats
pmc-13103573.creator: Qiuming Liu, Wanmei Biao, Xingchun Duan, Yujie Zhong, Qingyu Ma, Liping Sun, Yongliang Zhuang
pmc-13103573.description: This study investigated the in vivo metabolic fate of rambutan peel polyphenols (RPPs) in rats. RPPs consisted primarily of ellagitannins, notably geraniin (341.24 mg/g dry weight). Following a single oral gavage of RPPs, 75 metabolites derived from ellagic acid, gallic acid, corilagin, and urolithins were identified.

pmc-13610716.title: Chrono-Nutritional Disruption as a Potential Modifiable Factor in Bipolar Disorder
pmc-13610716.creator: Marianna Mazza, Giuseppe Marano
pmc-13610716.description: Bipolar disorder is characterized by marked circadian and metabolic vulnerability, but direct evidence linking the timing of food intake to its course remains sparse. This structured narrative review examines chrono-nutritional disruption, including irregular meal timing, nocturnal eating, prolonged or inconsistent fasting, eating-window variability, and eating jet lag, as a potential behavioral correlate and mechanistic contributor to bipolar instability.

pmc-13712296.title: Molecular mechanisms of YZG-331 ameliorated insomnia based on the gut microbiota–drug interaction
pmc-13712296.creator: Hengtong Zuo, Qinglan Guo, Bin Zhao, Jinyue Lu, Ru Feng, Jingyue Wang, Jianye Song, Jingyu Jin, Jiachun Hu, Yi Zhao, Hui Xu, Tiefeng Yuan, Wanxia Wang, Yongmei Tu, Lingyu Wei, Yifan Zhao, Xiang Hui, Zhihao Liu, Li Sheng, Yan Li, Jianjun Zhang, Jinlyu Sun, Jiangong Shi, Yan Wang
pmc-13712296.description: The gut microbiota plays a crucial role in the study of drug efficacy and metabolism. YZG-331 exhibits significant sedative and hypnotic effects. However, the oral bioavailability of YZG-331 in female mice remains low at 27.7%, and it exhibits instability in the gut microbiota, undergoing rapid metabolism, with the intestinal hydrolytic metabolite M2 identified as the characteristic metabolite.
